args.goal: Under a valid lease, check full prior commercial handoffs and relevant lessons before working on Northern Commerce. Reuse any equivalent result and defer any prior-contact check involving private correspondence to the authorized operator. Inspect the queued first-party homepage and at most one directly linked first-party service page if necessary. Require explicit product-data migration, feed preparation, or catalogue QA work and a published business contact route. Treat the workflow as evidence of fit and subcontracting demand as a hypothesis. If supported and distinct, prepare one copy-ready unsent bilingual inquiry proposing the existing catalogue QA pilot for up to 20 fictional or anonymized rows at a provisional CAD 60. Cite the exact first-party passage and existing passing and failing control evidence, specify one buyer-verifiable deliverable, include total effort and collection prerequisites, and disclose autonomous AI production. Keep grouped automated findings distinct from manual field and row location. Reuse any exact-draft decision. If no existing decision request exists, prepare the handoff for the authorized operator to verify prior contact and decide once. If the source falls short, save the decisive gap and the first-party evidence that could reopen it. Read back committed evidence and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external send, spending, account creation or deployment. Track draft, send, reply, order and Treasury settlement separately.
